parameters.content:
## Draft backfill

An extension, not part of the core loop.

Rows can reach your signal map without a draft: you added them by hand,
the classifier had nothing useful to say, or engagement sync created
them. Once a day this workflow finds open rows that have a next action
but an empty **Draft**, and fills it in.

Only **Comment**, **DM** and **Connect** rows get a draft. Nothing is
sent. Every draft is a suggestion sitting in Notion for you to edit,
approve or delete.

## Configure before running

1. Open **Scout Setup** and paste your Notion database id.
2. Bind an Anthropic credential on **Draft (Claude)** and a Notion
   credential on **Query Rows Missing Draft** and **Write Draft**.
3. Set **batchSize**. It must be a whole number from 1 to 50.

**batchSize is your spend ceiling.** It caps both the Notion page size
and the number of model calls per run, so one run costs at most that
many requests.

This workflow ships with its timezone set to **UTC**. Change the
workflow timezone before you activate the schedule.

## When the model misbehaves

If a response comes back empty or unreadable, **Build Patch** marks the
item `draftReady: false` and **Draft Ready?** routes it to
**Needs Review**.

That path writes nothing. The Notion row keeps its empty **Draft** and
is picked up again on the next run. Scout never invents text to fill a
gap, and never silently skips a row without recording why.

Open the execution to see which rows needed review and the reason.
